NewsArticle.Title: Optimization
NewsArticle.Content: Herbs may only be found in the Enchanted Garden. Nadurra (the elemental source) may be found everywhere again. This helps optimize your speed in combat areas. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
